descriptionMarkdown:
For early game mall, see my [second Gleba mall](https://factorioprints.com/view/-OFa_ZWh1hQypFqucMTy). 


### Mid-Game Gleba factory

##### Features
- Creates all Gleba unique items 
- 2,000 SPM
- Mall with all items you need to build more outposts
- Seeds management
- Self-Powered

##### Tech level
  - 5 Planets Tech, no quality
  - Artillery, Tesla Turrets are needed
  - Stack inserters and biochambers

##### Power-up:
- Connect ~5,000/min from each fruit from any side.
- Start the electric network. It is on a seperate network that will power everything once it started.
- 250 logistics bots
- Add 2,000 spoilage to the network
- 1 egg

##### Important Note:
- **As the factory stores the seeds in buffer chests, seed requesters in the farms must check "Request from buffer chests"**

##### About the design
- Each component processes the fruit it needs; there is no central processing area
- Each component makes its own nutrients
- One module creates the initial nutrients for all the other modules for simplicity and sends it via bots
- Lots of buffer chests - bots will arrange everything, no need for 10000 storage chests.

**As this massive blueprint is new, I consider it as a beta. Please report about any issue you find. Thanks!**
title: Gleba Mall  - 5 Planets Tech (2000 SPM)
